title: Remove duplicate values
hints: For each number, ask: is it already in the output? Only append it if it isn't.
The standard slices package has slices.Contains(s, v). Start from out := []int{} (not var out []int), so empty input gives a non-nil result.
out := []int{}; for _, n := range numbers { if !slices.Contains(out, n) { out = append(out, n) } }; return out
